# E0110: the lineage's directory has no version files

The lineage's directory holds no version files at all. A lineage is a
directory of `<major>.<minor>.thema` files, starting at 0.0.thema.

thema reports:

```
error[E0110]: the lineage has no version files
  |
  = help: a lineage is a directory of version files, <major>.<minor>.thema, starting at 0.0.thema
```
